name: track-teardown
description: Upload a song, get a step-by-step plan and MIDI to rebuild it in FL Studio.

scripts.test: node tests/metrics.test.js && node tests/timemap.test.js && node tests/timemap-sync.test.js && node tests/timing-consumers.test.js && node tests/bench-metrics.test.js && node tests/bench-integrity.test.js && node tests/bench-holdout.test.js && node tests/bench-regions.test.js && node tests/bench-target.test.js && node tests/dev-server.test.js && node tests/run-tests.js
scripts.bench:synthetic: node bench/run.js test-songs/manifest.json --out bench/out/synthetic && node bench/score.js bench/out/synthetic/predictions.json
scripts.bench:time-fixtures: node bench/run.js test-songs/time-fixtures/manifest.json --out bench/out/time-fixtures && node bench/score.js bench/out/time-fixtures/predictions.json && node bench/time-fixtures-summary.js bench/out/time-fixtures
